summary: The PR proposes a sensible default for SECURE_REFERRER_POLICY, but there are concerns about potential regressions and documentation.

issues.description: Changing the default value of SECURE_REFERRER_POLICY to 'same-origin' may break existing applications that rely on the Referer header for verification purposes.
The PR does not include an update to the documentation to reflect the new default value for SECURE_REFERRER_POLICY.
